output.summary: Fixed the reviewer's high finding in orders/validation.py. An order that crosses zero is now judged on the new opposite position alone, which must be within the limit. Non-crossing orders keep the old rule: breach only if abs(new) > abs(current) and abs(new) > limit. I replaced the test that allowed an over-limit flip with tests for rejected over-limit flips and for flips landing exactly on the limit. tests/ passes (18) and invariants/ passes (9), including inv 5 and 6 on flips.
concerns: Pre-existing: the margin check runs on reducing and closing orders and can reject them with INSUFFICIENT_MARGIN. This conflicts with AGENTS.md rule 5 and is still unfixed. I did not change it, so a human needs to decide.
Limit values are not validated. A negative limit blocks every increasing order. The contract doesn't cover this, so I left it as is.
The limit check runs after the margin check, so an order that fails both reports INSUFFICIENT_MARGIN.
output.notes_for_next_session: What I did: in _breaches_position_limit (orders/validation.py), a flip through zero (current * new < 0) now breaches if abs(new) > limit, whatever happens to the abs size. Non-flip orders are judged as before. This matches invariants inv 5 and 6, which were already in the repo, so I did not edit them. In tests/test_validation.py I replaced the obsolete test that allowed an over-limit flip with test_limit_flip_into_over_limit_rejected. I also added test_limit_flip_landing_exactly_on_limit_allowed, which covers BUY and SELL, long and short, and an exact close. Both suites pass (18 and 9). Left for a human: (1) The margin check rejects reducing and closing orders, which conflicts with AGENTS.md rule 5. The invariants use RICH margin so they don't catch it. I left the behavior alone. (2) Limit values are not validated, so a negative limit blocks every increasing order. (3) The limit check runs after the margin check. Trap: the shell allow-list hook blocks git log and compound commands, so use single commands plus the Read and Edit tools.
